arguments.content: Recovery state-machine review pattern: provider-applied is not necessarily request-completed. If a receipt write fails and the contract permits edited values on retry, skipping provider application solely because the record is applied falsely acknowledges new values while retaining the earlier payload. Reapply the latest retry payload for unfinished operations when replacement is idempotent, update audit values to the payload actually applied, and preserve the terminal completed-operation short circuit. Verify initial state, post-provider/pre-receipt failure, edited retry, completed replay and later fresh operation through the actual client. Staged save recovery update versus HEAD feeb199add2b6ae7b800a45b7b6856ab45ad2a67 reproduced false success while all three existing tests passed. P1.
